submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a targeted local restoration of an existing Daoist Q-style hand-painted coastal map, not a new scene. Image 1 is the exact 1254 x 1254 native edit target. Return one native 1254 x 1254 PNG with exactly the same framing, scale, camera, palette, rock positions, object identities and registration. Repair the long diagonal cut crossing the pale upright rocks near local x210–760,y220–385, including the rock silhouette next to sand. Also repair the chopped dark wedge/zigzag seam inside the narrow cleft between the large boulders near local x680–800,y600–860. Restore continuous curved stone faces and unbroken occlusion shadows. Preserve every boulder identity, size and location; do not broaden the rock mass or narrow the sandy passage. Change only the described defects inside crop-local rectangle [115, 115, 1139, 1139]. Preserve every pixel outside that allowed rectangle as closely as possible, especially the outer 115 pixels on every side. Away from the defects do not repaint, smooth or recolor anything. Preserve fine matte hand-painted gray/slate stone, warm sunlight, sand and existing shadows. Correct the geometry and light continuity at original native detail; no blur, feather haze, resizing, perspective shift, invented content, buildings, UI, lettering or watermark. Fixed unchanged context around the repair is essential for seamless native patch insertion.
